_note: Starts EMPTY on purpose. licenses.py fails closed and names any package that lacks embedded info/licenses evidence (or whose licence it cannot derive). The conda spec is now a MINIMAL BASE (python 3.11 + conda-pack + setuptools) and the WHOLE ML export stack is pip-installed at CI build (torch==2.2.0/torchvision==0.17.0 from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu; numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.12.0 onnx==1.15.0 onnxruntime==1.29.0 safetensors==0.4.2 timm==0.9.16 einops from PyPI), so this inventory covers those as pip identities (pip://name==version) rather than conda builds. The first waft-validation EL8 dispatch reports the exact packages+URLs to add here -- the conda base packages bound to their CI-solved build, and each pip package (torch and its bundled libs, torchvision, numpy, scipy, onnx, onnxruntime, safetensors, timm, einops) by its wheel -- see bakeoff/p25-6/runtime-license-supplement.json for the shape of a populated file.
